endpoints.description: Query earthquake events by time, magnitude, location radius, depth; format=geojson
Count of events matching a query without returning them

limits.notes: Single query limited to 20,000 events; requests that would exceed this return HTTP 400. Use time windows or magnitude floors to page.

llmDocs.summary: Global earthquake event catalog (real-time and historical) via the FDSN event web service. No key. GeoJSON output.
llmDocs.queryGuide: Always set format=geojson. Filter with starttime, endtime, minmagnitude, and a radius (latitude/longitude/maxradiuskm) or bounding box. Use /count first to check result size before /query.

exampleQueries.intent: M4.5+ quakes in the last day worldwide

gotchas: 20,000-event hard cap per query; broad time+low magnitude queries 400 out — paginate by time.
Times are UTC ISO8601; omitting endtime defaults to present.
There are convenience GeoJSON feeds (e.g. summary/all_day.geojson) for common windows that need no parameters.

compliance.redistributionNotes: USGS data is public domain. Attribution to USGS recommended.
